s.en: push records into the Samba event log store

syn: eventlogadm [-s] [-d] [-h] -o addsource EVENTLOG SOURCENAME MSGFILE ⏎ eventlogadm [-s] [-d] [-h] -o write EVENTLOG ⏎ eventlogadm [-s] [-d] [-h] -o dump EVENTLOG RECORD_NUMBER

o.en: The -s option causes eventlogadm to load the configuration file given as FILENAME instead of the default one used by Samba.
The -d option causes eventlogadm to emit debugging information.
The -o addsource option creates a new event log source.
